title: Shopping now starts with AI, so our store must win in agents and feeds
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US consumers would use GenAI for gifts (Gartner). Google launched Universal Cart; Amex built agent-purchase checks; Best Buy joined TikTok Shop; memory shortage drives record PC price inflation (Counterpoint).

points.headline: AI discovery and carts are becoming the front door to purchase
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% of consumers use AI in discovery and Gartner 34% for gift ideas. Google's Universal Cart spans Search and Gemini. We should ready product feeds, content and checkout for it.

points.headline: Agent-made orders are turning trust and payments into a new requirement
points.detail: American Express launched a framework to verify purchases made by AI shopping agents. We should watch how issuers authenticate agent orders and make sure our store's checkout can accommodate them.

points.headline: Memory shortage is lifting PC prices and costs into 2027
points.detail: Counterpoint reports record PC price inflation and DigiTimes sees DRAM and NAND prices rising into Q4 on AI demand. We should plan pricing, promotions and inventory for tighter margins.

points.headline: Electronics retail is widening channels as holiday demand grows
points.detail: Best Buy joined TikTok Shop, Target pairs deals with an AI assistant, and Adobe forecasts $275.1B US online holiday sales (+6.7%). We should test channels and Cyber 5 offers.
